Build passes too. Here's what the sandbox turned up.

## What I did

I used `RunScript` to cross-reference all 140 source + 82 test files in a handful of passes — parsing every `export`, indexing every identifier, and intersecting the two. That's a whole-repo analysis that would've been hundreds of individual tool calls.

Of 707 exported symbols, **15 were referenced exactly once: by their own declaration.** I verified each with an independent `git grep` before touching anything, and checked that no `.css`/`.html` asset referenced them dynamically.

## The interesting part — two weren't dead, they were *unwired*

**`docsEvaluationKickoff` (`src/agent/phases/docs-evaluation.ts:35`) looks like a real bug.** Every other phase kickoff — `reconcileKickoff`, `implementKickoff`, `cleanupKickoff`, `docsMapKickoff` — is imported and sent in `chat-view-provider.ts`. This one never is. Its own docstring says *"The first message: there is nothing to configure, so the session starts on the job"*, but `newSession` only sends a prompt `if (prompt)`, so a docs-evaluation session starts silent and waits for the user to type. **I left it untouched** — wiring it changes runtime behavior and that's your call, not mine.

**`INDEX_DIR = 'types'`** was dead while the literal `types/` was hardcoded in two places (`summary.ts:34`, `build-map.ts:45`). The constant existed precisely to prevent that, so I wired it up rather than deleting it.

Also worth knowing: `MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 32 * 1024` claimed to be "the ceiling on JSON a tool call may return," but the actual cap is `BUDGET = MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS - ENVELOPE_CHARS` in `json.ts`. Stale leftover from the Docs-MCP copy — misleading, so removed.

## Removed (13 symbols, 14 files, −45/+7)

Mostly thin aliases that shadowed the real thing: `docsMapDir`→`docsMapRoot`, `docsIndexPath`→`indexFile`, `DOCS_MAP_TIME_BOUND_MS`/`REPO_MAP_TIME_BOUND_MS`→`CONTEXT_TIME_BOUND_MS`, plus `summaryFile`, `summaryMapPath`, `newestSource`, `publicTypeCount`, `commentsFor`, `SessionEventType`, `nodeOnPath` (the never-chosen alternative to `hostExecutableAsNode`), and `stepChoices` (superseded — `profiles-tab.ts` computes it inline).

The script also self-audited for imports the deletions orphaned, found 7, and fixed them — final re-check came back clean.

## Verification

Baseline before, identical after: **typecheck clean, 80 files / 853 tests passing, esbuild bundle builds.** Nothing is committed.

One caveat worth flagging: my first test run reported *all 80 files failing*. That was `--reporter=dot` misbehaving, not real — `npm test` was green all along. Worth knowing before that flag bites you in CI.

Two leads if you want to keep pulling: **113 more exports are used only inside their own file** (over-exported internals — `session-manager.ts` and `workspace-scan.ts` are the worst offenders), and **19 modules have no test touching any of their exports**, led by `chat-view-provider.ts` at 1273 lines.
